title: The Perfect Pencil Puzzle
description:
*** Today's Puzzle ***

Some of you have requested that we occasionally take on a tougher "pencil puzzle" than those seen in the Genuinely Approachable Pencil Puzzle (GAPP) series. Your wish is our command!  Today we take on BenceJoful's Star Nurikabe - which is just an amazing and beautiful problem. Give it a try at the link below: 

https://git.io/Jzwdj

Rules: 
(Almost) Standard 2-star Star Battle and Nurikabe rules apply. ie

title: Seven:  The Sudoku
description:
*** Today's Sudoku ***

Phistomefel has created a 6x6 puzzle which almost defies belief.  Originally Mark felt this sudoku may not be interesting for everyone who normally follows the channel - it is VERY unusual.  However it is that clever - and we know you like clever things - that we want this puzzle to have the widest possible audience.  We hope you agree and enjoy watching Simon battle with a strange and wonderful problem! Play the puzzle at the link below: 

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/hHRtRmf448

Rules: 
Place the digits 1 to 6 once each in every row, column and region. The regions need to be determined and each is a set of six connected cells.  Two orthogonally connected cells belong to different regions if and only if their digits add up to 7. Digits along a thermometer increase from the bulb end.

title: Normal Sudoku Rules CANNOT Apply
description:
*** Today's Sudoku ***

Where to start...  this is one of the greatest puzzles we've ever seen.  A stunningly original concept executed with vicious and ingenious wit by Isaac Resnikoff.  Simon apologises (as usual) for the length of the video but surely this isn't an easy sudon'tku? Play the puzzle at the link below: 

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/3Tbt4Ftqnj

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules CANNOT apply: no digit can appear exactly once in any row, box, or column. There are exactly nine of each digit. Digits cannot appear exactly once within a cage and cannot sum to the value indicated. Digits along a thermometer strictly do not increase from the bulb end: they may decrease or stay the same, but never increase. Numbers with a black dot between them cannot have a ratio of 2.

title: Gas Vegas
description:
Here are this week's 5 Genuinely Approachable Sudoku (GAS) puzzles: 
GAS 186 – Kropkidrome by Clover: https://tinyurl.com/2p9y8ut7 
Normal sudoku rules apply. The sequence of digits along a grey line forms a palindrome: that is, each grey line reads the same forwards as backwards. Digits on either side of a white dot must be consecutive. Digits on either side of a black dot must be in a 1:2 ratio. Not all dots are necessarily given.
GAS 187 – Palindrome Quads by Sam Cappleman-Lynes: https://tinyurl.com/ytx3yat2 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Numbers placed on a grey line must form a palindromic sequence; that is, they must read the same in both directions. The numbers appearing in a white circle must be placed somewhere in the four cells surrounding the circle.
GAS 188 Squared Circle by Philip Newman: https://tinyurl.com/ypz8fhhb 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits along an arrow must sum to the circled total. Digits in a (corner) circle must appear in the surrounding four cells, in any order.
GAS 189 – LK Arrow by Clover: https://tinyurl.com/nhzuphwa 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits along an arrow sum to the value in the attached bulb. Digits may repeat along an arrow, as long as they follow sudoku rules. Some diagonals are marked outside of the grid. Digits along a marked diagonal sum to the value given. Digits may repeat along a diagonal, as long as they follow sudoku rules. 
GAS 190 – Renban Quads by Sam Cappleman-Lynes: https://tinyurl.com/hj5fu4xb  
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits on a grey line must form a set of consecutive digits, in any order. Digits in a white circle must appear somewhere in the four cells surrounding the circle.

Here's where you can try 2022 Sudoku by James Kopp: https://tinyurl.com/2p8a6bwz 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits along a thermometer must increase from the bulb to the end. Cells joined by a white dot contain consecutive digits. Not all dots are given. The three “2” thermometers are clones, with the same digits in the same positions.

title: Is This Sudoku Impossible To Solve Without Using Geometry?
description:
*** Today's Sudoku ***

A debut on the channel today for Krangune and their puzzle Spokes.  We also take a brief look at the new viral word game Wordle which some of you may have seen on Twitter recently.  Play the puzzle at the link below: 

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/7BgqG63BR9

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. In cages, digits must sum to the small clue in the top left corner of  the cage. Digits on grey lines form palindromes ie they must read the same forwards and backwards.  eg 13731.

The game Wordle can be found here:
https://www.powerlanguage.co.uk/wordle/
